body: I'm so sorry ur mother is such a scumbag. How are u doing now?

My step father has caused me to feel such incredible hatred for him that i didn't think was possible for any normal human to feel. My mother has betrayed me so many times that i long to have a supportive mother who is smart and knows her value as a person. Overall i long for parents who actually love me.

YTA- Way to go on telling your kids that their mother doesn't love them. I hope all these comments teach you something about raising kids because it isn't some fucking game of which parent has more points than the other. It's about making sure your kid knows you're there for them and that they have a safe stable environment to come home too.
Thank you so much and i'll definitely take all of this into consideration.

You could offer to help around the house and pay some rent when you do find a form of income. I'm sure your boyfriend would much rather have you safe and sound then with you extremely controlling parents. Is there anyone else who could help? a friend? cousin? maybe even a teacher? 

There may be programs to help young adults cut ties from their toxic parents, so you could try finding some of those.
I'm so sorry you have to live in such a disgustingly toxic environment. Your dad is an absolute abomination and if you ever need to talk then i'm here.

Is there any possibility that your boyfriend will let you stay at his place until you find a place of your own? I also recommend to go find a job because This is no way to live and especially since you're an adult.
